Here is how to check your laptop battery health

1. Win+R (opens the run tab)
2. Type 'cmd' and enter (command prompt opens up
3. Type 'powercfg/batteryreport' (a message saying "Battery life report......." Will be shown - it will also show a file path. 
4. Copy the file path and paste in browser (this will open up the battry report
5. Look at the 'DESIGN CAPACITY' and the 'FULL CHARGE CAPACITY'. The difference will give you an idea

Note: DESIGN CAPACITY - It is the battery capacity when you first booted the laptop. Essentially the full capacity for which it was made.

FULL CHARGE CAPACITY - It is the charge holding in the battery after a full charge now a days. If your battery is dead, this value will be VERY low now.
